contract.definition: loanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstances()->any(lr: LoanRequest | lr.RequestID = id)
contract.postcondition: let approvalLetter: ApprovalLetter in approvalLetter.oclIsNew() and ApprovalLetter.allInstances()->includes(approvalLetter) and approvalLetter.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent' and self.CurrentApprovalLetter = approvalLetter and self.CurrentLoanRequest = loanRequest and loanRequest.AttachedApprovalLetter = approvalLetter and result = true
